criterion: Feedback after action; user knows what happened
description: Joining an agent-only box with `--harness openai-codex --name "Overnight Codex"` enrolls the box into the existing Codex Actor of the same person (the laptop's 'Setup agent'). The new name is silently dropped, so the board shows no 'Overnight Codex', and work from the box and from the laptop is attributed to one indistinguishable Actor.
expected: Either a distinct Actor named as requested, or the join result says it reused the existing 'Setup agent' Actor and ignored --name.
actual: Join succeeds silently; hub actor list has only 'Setup agent' with Devices filament.local and ci-mini-02.
suggested_fix: Report the reused Actor and ignored name in the join result; consider letting the person rename an agent Actor or distinguish per-device agents.

description: On an agent-only box an unused sign-in link is refused (bootstrap 403) but the page says 'The sign-in link was already used or has expired' and advises asking the agent to run `pardner client open`, which fails with `FORBIDDEN: Human authority required` on that box. 'Check again' clears the notice without changing anything.
expected: 'This computer joined as an agent only; people use Pardner from their own computer' with no impossible advice.
actual: Wrong reason and a loop back to a failing command.
suggested_fix: Map the agent-only FORBIDDEN from /bootstrap and /session to a dedicated signed-out state.

description: `client open` and `client invite` on an agent-only box return only `FORBIDDEN: Human authority required`; `client list` on the box does not show that it is agent-only.
expected: The error and `client list` say this client joined as an agent only and that people should use their own client.
actual: Generic authority error, no state flag.
suggested_fix: Add humanAuthority:false to client list and an explanatory message/details to the FORBIDDEN.

description: Priya's human profile lists the agent-only boxes ci-mini-02 and ci-mini-03 under Devices, though she has no browser authority on them.
expected: Agent-only devices appear only on the agent Actors, or are labeled 'agent only'.
actual: Human profile Devices: filament.local, ci-mini-02, ci-mini-03.
suggested_fix: Exclude devices without human authority from the human Actor's Devices or mark them.

description: An agent named 'Cursor (ci)' gets the avatar initials 'C(' in the avatar stack and profile.
suggested_fix: Strip non-letter characters before computing initials.
